title: Strawberry Shortcake
description: Tender, lightly sweet cream biscuits split and piled with juicy sugared strawberries and softly whipped cream.

image.alt: A split biscuit filled with strawberries and whipped cream

steps.text: Toss the strawberries with the sugar and leave them to release their juices while you make the shortcakes, at least {time 20 min}.
Heat the oven to {temp 425F oven} and line the baking sheet. Whisk the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt, then rub in the butter until it looks like coarse crumbs.
Stir in the cream with a fork until the dough just holds together. Pat it {len 3/4 in} thick and cut into {count 8} squares or rounds. Brush with cream and sprinkle with sugar.
Bake until golden, {time 14-16 min}. Cool for {time 10 min}.
Whip the cream with the powdered sugar and vanilla to soft peaks. Split the shortcakes, fill with strawberries and their juice and a big spoonful of cream, and replace the tops.

notes: Assemble just before serving so the shortcakes stay crisp on the outside.
